findings.where: Favorites tab — saved prompt entries (src/ui/FavoritesView.tsx lines 105-106)
findings.expected: Subject/difficulty chips on saved entries use display labels like the generator card: 'Real Estate', 'Law', 'Easy'
findings.found: Raw internal enum values are rendered ('realEstate', 'law', 'easy'); the chip's uppercase styling turns the camelCase identifier into the smashed word 'REALESTATE' visible to the user
findings.evidence: Rendered favorites text captured via browse: '...calendarlaweasy9812CopyRemove...realEstateeasyEDC3CopyRemove'; screenshot .swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-favorites-raw-enums.png shows chips 'LAW', 'EASY', 'REALESTATE'. FavoritesView.tsx renders {f.prompt.subject}/{f.prompt.difficulty} directly while PromptCard.tsx maps through SUBJECT_LABELS/DIFFICULTY_LABELS.

findings.where: Generator — prompt card text (src/core/generate.ts line 48 + template data)
findings.expected: Prompt text ends in a 'Twist:' sentence — i.e. the body ends with punctuation before 'Twist:' starts a new sentence
findings.found: 24 of 48 templates have no terminal punctuation, so half of all generations render a run-on where the body collides with the twist: '...counting down in plain language Twist: Let users export the deadline...'
findings.evidence: Deterministic rendered card (seed 12345, Law+Easy) shows 'counting down in plain language Twist: Let users export...' — screenshot .swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-card-law-easy.png. Data probe via the live module: getTemplates({}) → {"total":48,"noEndPunct":24, examples: 're-01: ..._horizon} and shows the break-even point', 're-02: ...g but public data you scrape or hardcode'}. generate() appends `${resolved} Twist: ${twist}` with no separator.

findings.where: Favorites tab — serial tag on saved entries (src/ui/FavoritesView.tsx line 107)
findings.expected: .serial-tag rendered as 'No XXXX' (format used on the generator prompt card, e.g. 'No 9812')
findings.evidence: Screenshot .swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-favorites-raw-enums.png (serial chips read '9812' and 'EDC3'); same session's generator card showed 'No 9812' for the identical saved prompt (.swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-card-law-easy.png).

findings.where: Prompt card Copy/Save buttons and Favorites Copy/Remove buttons (both viewports)
findings.expected: Action buttons styled consistently with the rest of the designed UI (styled chips, hero, tabs all have custom CSS)
findings.found: Copy/Save/Remove render as raw browser-default buttons inside otherwise fully styled cards; no CSS rules exist for .copy-button, .save-button, or .prompt-actions in src/styles/app.css (grep returned zero matches)
findings.evidence: Screenshots .swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-card-law-easy.png and .swarm/runs/cycle-007-look-qa-mobile-375-generator.png show default-chrome buttons under the styled tag chips; `grep -n 'copy-button\|save-button\|prompt-actions\|fav-item' src/styles/app.css` returned nothing.
